article.story: WASHINGTON -- — Lovro Urbiha’s 13 points helped George Washington defeat Elon 69-50 on Tuesday. Urbiha added seven rebounds for the Revolutionaries (3-0). Dylan James scored 12 points and added 13 rebounds and three blocks. Jean Aranguren shot 3 of 7 from the field and 6 for 8 from the line to finish with 12 points. Josh Dalton led the way for the Phoenix (2-1) with 15 points, 12 rebounds, two steals and three blocks. Hunter Harding added eight points and six rebounds for Elon. George Washington held a 23-22 lead at halftime. James scored eight first-half points. George Washington pulled away with an 11-0 run in the second half to extend a seven-point lead to 18 points. Urbiha led the way with a team-high 10 second-half points. Up next Both teams next play Friday. George Washington hosts Harvard and Elon plays Chattanooga at home. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
